records.title: Minimum-repair structure and exact contracted solving
records.statement: Even two-port module necklaces with no spanning port-to-port path, port-starting paths and costs B(2+repair_indicator)+s, 0<=s<=W, B>nW, have k/2 repairs in every optimum. Two alternating connector patterns characterize that face. Endpoint-separable repairs give an exact local-table formula; arbitrary secondary repairs have an exact subset DP on m=k/2 paired path units. Forced-edge completion bounds are safe.
records.remaining: The module representation and primary gap are input promises. The optimized local-table complexity is O(n^2+kb^2 2^b+m^2b^3 2^m); the prototype enumerates local paths. No universal TSP runtime or practical benchmark improvement is established.

records.title: Completion separates from all rooted forced 1-tree bounds
records.statement: For every even k>=18, a strict four-cost integer metric on n=10k cities has a unique optimum T. All forced rooted 1-tree bounds at every root and real vertex potential are below OPT; completion bounds delete every non-T edge. The retained 180-city instance has OPT=66789 and retains 180 of 16110 edges.
records.remaining: This is a constructed separating family, not a blinded benchmark or a comparison against all LP cuts, local elimination methods or complete solvers. Earlier fractional-witness ingredients remain attributed to the handoff.

records.title: Deterministic quadratic 2-opt descent on bounded blocks
records.statement: On positive weighted shortest-path metrics with all generating vertices as cities, all nonzero 2-opt block gains share a sign. Every strict descent has at most n sum_B D_B 2^(D_B-1) moves, D_B=binom(|B|,2). Maximum block size b gives n(n-1)b 2^(binom(b,2)-2); b=4 gives 64n(n-1), from any initializer/pivot.
records.remaining: This is a move-count result with real-arithmetic scope, not nearest-neighbor quality, global optimality on cyclic blocks, bounded-treewidth generality or a 3-opt theorem. REVIEW.md corrects a repeated-label triangle witness without changing the result. General weight compression is established background.
